# HyperOS App Vault Mod **The HyperOS App Vault (-1 screen) with high-end features unlocked on every device.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/HyperOS-App-Vault?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-App-Vault/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/HyperOS-App-Vault/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-App-Vault/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/HyperOS-App-Vault?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-App-Vault/stargazers) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-channel-26A5E4?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)
## Features - Unlocks the widgets and features of high-end devices, with a switch that spoofs a high-end device (HyperOS 3 supported) - Translates all online widgets into your language in real time - Glassy blur background for stock widgets, with adjustable blur - Higher limit on widgets that can be added to the home screen - Scrolling animations ## Requirements - HyperOS - Magisk, KernelSU or APatch ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-App-Vault/releases/latest). 2. Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch. 3. Reboot your device. ## Notes - Global/CN ROMs on Android 14 or newer: flash [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) first. ---
Made by **[🅺🅰🆂🅷🅸](https://t.me/kakashi1v1)** · part of **[Mods Center](https://github.com/Mods-Center)** [Website](https://modscenter.org) · [Channel](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs) · [Support group](https://t.me/bootloop_discussion) · [Report a bug](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-App-Vault/issues)

HyperOS App Vault Mod

The HyperOS App Vault (-1 screen) with high-end features unlocked on every device.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-App-Vault/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-App-Vault/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-App-Vault/stargazers)

![Telegram](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)

Features

  • Unlocks the widgets and features of high-end devices, with a switch that spoofs a high-end device (HyperOS 3 supported)
  • Translates all online widgets into your language in real time
  • Glassy blur background for stock widgets, with adjustable blur
  • Higher limit on widgets that can be added to the home screen
  • Scrolling animations

    • Requirements

  • HyperOS
  • Magisk, KernelSU or APatch

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-App-Vault/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch.
  • Reboot your device.

    • Notes

  • Global/CN ROMs on Android 14 or newer: flash [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) first.
